title: Strawberry Cloud Bread
description: A giant, fluffy strawberry-flavoured cloud bread made with just 3 ingredients, perfect for a high-protein dessert.
steps: Add egg whites + sweetener into a bowl
Use an electric mixer and whip for around 8 minutes until thick and fluffy
notes:
This recipe comes out somewhere between a soufflé, cake and cloud bread. It's perfect for when you want dessert but still want to smash your protein for the day! You can eat the whole thing without guilt. The author also mentions that chocolate protein powder would be amazing in this recipe.
